release_notes: Facebook integration, both directions. Cost import never actually worked: the insights request asked for a field named 'currency', which does not exist on that endpoint, and Meta rejects the whole request when one field identifier is wrong - so every sync returned zero rows and reported success. Clicks also never stored the ad_id/adset_id/campaign_id the traffic-source template advertises, so even imported spend could not be attached to a click. Both are fixed: capture now lives in one shared helper used by the redirect path and the Click API, attribution runs ad -> adset -> campaign, spend is converted from the ad account's currency into the tracker's, the sync window covers the last 5 days (30 on first sync) because platforms restate spend for days afterwards, and API errors surface with Meta's own message instead of looking like an empty report. New: Facebook Conversions API - conversions are sent to Meta server-side with fbc/fbp, IP, user agent and hashed email/phone/geo, deduplicated against the browser pixel by event_id, delivered through the existing S2S retry queue. Facebook connections gained an API version selector and proxy support. New keys are translated in all seven locales.
